feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Iteration 4 (50 mm span, y = 0.075 m, kd 0.4) scored 291.9, the best so far. The oval finished 15 of 20 runs with progress 0.81, and steering_oscillation fell to 0.16 after kd rose from 0.3 to 0.4 (iteration 3 had 0.20 to 0.24). The s-bend and slalom still lost the line in all 40 runs, with line_loss_events at 2.0 on both and max_error at 0.072 and 0.066. Your 60 mm span at y = 0.075 m is the right next step, because the forward array is already at its limit and the span is the variable that moved coverage earlier (iteration 0 to 1 cut line loss on the oval). Next race: if line_loss_events is still at least 1 on the s-bend or slalom at 60 mm, try a larger footprint (sensor_size 0.016 m) before changing wheel_track, because it widens each sensor's view of the tape edge without moving the array. If line_loss_events is 0 on all tracks but max_error stays at or above 0.06 and the robot still leaves the track, reduce wheel_track from 0.12 m to about 0.10 m for more turn rate. Keep body_width at 0.12 m, since the off-track limit sits at its 0.06 m floor and body width does not change it.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events is still at least 1 on the s-bend or slalom at x = ±0.03 m, try sensor_size 0.016 m with the same positions, so each footprint covers more of the tape edge at the forward limit.
If line_loss_events drops to 0 but max_error stays at or above 0.06, reduce wheel_track from 0.12 m to about 0.10 m for more turn rate (iteration 4 max_error was 0.066 to 0.072 on the bends).
Keep body_width at 0.12 m and mass at 0.6 kg until turning authority is shown to limit the outcome; the off-track limit is already at its 0.06 m floor.
